findings.title: Cache is not rechecked after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: GetWebAssets reads entryPointAssetsCache under RLock, releases the lock, and then acquires the exclusive lock without checking the cache again. In non-dev mode, multiple goroutines that observed a nil cache can all proceed to load the manifest; a later goroutine can overwrite a cache that was already populated by an earlier goroutine. If that later load fails, it can replace a valid cached value with nil. Recheck entryPointAssetsCache after Lock and return the existing value before doing I/O in non-dev mode.

findings.title: Failed loads overwrite the cache with nil
findings.body: The function assigns entryPointAssetsCache = result unconditionally, even when err != nil and result is nil. Combined with the missing re-check after acquiring the write lock, a stale initialization that errors can clear a previously populated cache. Unless explicit invalidation is intended, the cache should only be updated when the load succeeds.
